author: Inside Edition
description: Indigenous groups say they're watching sacred land disappear as the US moves forward with constructing a wall along the border with Mexico. Norma Meza Calles, a tribal leader, holds vigils for Kuuchamaa Mountain, which she says gives her and the people of the Kumeyaay tribe strength to live in a difficult world. Construction on the border wall has been ramped up since the beginning of 2026. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Tribes Say Sacred Land Is Being Destroyed To Construct Border Wall

author: Inside Edition
description: The long-lost remains of 44 Revolutionary War soldiers will finally get proper burial after 250 years in a New York State town. A public reinterment ceremony was held on Friday, May 22, 2026, when the soldiers’ remains were finally laid to rest with honor at Lake George Battlefield Park in Lake George, New York. The remains were discovered in 2019 during construction work in what has since been known as Courtland Street Burying Ground. Research suggested that the soldiers likely died in the summer of 1776 inside a makeshift hospital at Fort George after contracting smallpox or another disease while serving in Canada.
title: Remains of Over 40 Soldiers From Revolutionary War Finally Buried
